component.name: Cours Radioamateur
component.summary: Course for the French amateur radio operator certificate

description.p: Offline reader for the course "Préparation au certificat d'opérateur du service amateur" written by F6GPX for the Radio-Club de la Haute Île (F6KGL / F5KFF): regulation and technique chapters, with every schematic redrawn as a native vector figure, light and dark themes and adjustable text size.
